title: OpenCues OPENCUES.md frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of OPENCUES.md, the runtime config file. NOT part of the standard — runtime-specific. See /packages/opencues-runtime/SPEC.md.

blanks-llm-provider.description: Default provider for all blank-bucket sources (fluid-blank, transform-blank, blank-context). Per-aspect scalars (fluid-blank-provider etc.) win when set.

cues-llm-provider.description: Default provider for cue-bucket sources (word-cues, sentence-cues).

auditors-llm-provider.description: Default provider for the auditor bucket (also covers agent-rewrite). Refuses trainsOnInput providers — prose-bearing.

identity-context-mode.description: Gates IDENTITY.md personal-data injection into fluid-blank and transform-blank as sentinel tokens. `safe`: tokens-only catalog to LLM, values substituted post-response. `raw`: values inlined into prompt (PII reaches provider logs; hidden from cycling menu). See spec/identity-context-spec.md.

blank-context-mode.description: Gates blank-as-context (blanks with as-context: safe|raw expose their values as ambient [BLANK NAME] tokens). Mode-gate composition: `raw` MUST be downgraded to `safe` when identity-context-mode is not also `raw`.

ambient-context-mode.description: Chrome-only. Gates ambient field-metadata (label + placeholder + page-title) injection into fluid-blank for label-aware disambiguation.

sentence-cues-mode.description: Gates SentenceCueSource (scope: sentence cues that emit whole-sentence rewrites cycleable via the existing word-cue path).

fluid-config-mode.description: Gates ConfigIntentSource (semantic `_` classifier targeting FEATURES registry scalars). Settings-only; user blanks excluded.

blank-trigger-mode.description: When blank fill fires after the user types `_`. immediate = on next keystroke; spaced = waits for a trailing space.

nav-keymap.description: Cycling keymap profile. Values come from MENU_TUNABLES; default `ctrl-alt-arrows`.

agent-window-words.description: Sliding-window mode: 0 = full-buffer, N>0 = ~N words around cursor.

agent-debounce-ms.description: Debounce after last keystroke before AgentRewrite ticks (ms). Misparse / non-positive → 1000.
